summary: App for users to write and save food preservation tips/secrets, and view simple science explanations/methods for improving food safety and longevity.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Warm kitchen notebook-style app logo: a simple line-art jar and leaf with hand-drawn feel on a cream background (app-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide hero banner illustration of a pantry shelf with jars, labels, and subtle texture in earthy tones (hero-pantry.dim_1600x600.png)
- Minimal icon set (3 icons) in consistent line style: jar, snowflake, salt (icons-set.dim_384x128.png)

existing_features.title: Create a clean, easy-to-use frontend UI that lets users browse their saved tips and browse the science methods library, with separate navigation entries for “My Tips” and “Science Library”.
Add frontend flows to create and edit a tip, including a form with title, content, and tags, plus actions to save changes and delete a tip.
Use React Query for all backend data fetching/mutations and ensure caches are invalidated/refreshed appropriately after create/update/delete operations for tips.

Define and apply a consistent visual theme for the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) with a distinct “warm kitchen notebook” aesthetic using earthy tones (avoid blue/purple) across all screens.

Add a frontend static-assets integration for generated images by rendering them from frontend/public/assets/generated (e.g., logo/hero/section icons) and using them in the header and/or empty states without routing images through the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow users to create, edit, and save their own food preservation tips/secrets.
Provide a section/library of simple science explanations and methods for preserving food and improving food resources.
Enable browsing/viewing of saved tips and science methods in a clean, easy-to-use interface.

Implement backend data model and API to allow each authenticated user (by Principal) to create, read, update, and delete their own food preservation tips/secrets, including fields: id, title, content, optional tags, createdAt, updatedAt.

Implement backend API to provide a read-only library of simple science explanations and methods for preserving food and improving food resources. Include fields: id, title, summary, steps (optional), safetyNotes (optional), and category.

projectName: Food Preservation Tips App: CRUD tips + science methods library
